 (Vacation Court)
 Date : 04th June, 2024.

PER COURT :
1. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 24.06.2024.
2.
Learned APP waives service of notice for respondent/State.
3. Heard the learned Counsel for the applicant on the point of interim relief.

4. Learned Advocate for the applicant submits that only the role alleged against this applicant is that he asked accused Saberi Noman Ahmed Sayyed Ahmed vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198923612/

sentences.text: 1 No . 3 Alok Reddy to verify as to whether the vehicle carrying alleged Ghutka is seized by the police.
He submits that there is no any other allegation except this.
Police is trying to implicate him only on the basis of statement of one of the accused in the alleged offence.
His name does not appear in the FIR.

He further submits that this Court has already protected another accused Mohammad Jahir Ahmed Bashir Bhojani against whom similar allegations are made by order dated 27.05.2024 in ABA No. 861 of 2024.
5. Considering the above, this Court is inclined to grant ad-interim protection to the present applicant.

Hence the following order :
 ORDER a) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of the applicant Saberi Noman Ahmed Sayeed Ahmed, in connection with Crime No. 246 of 2024 registered with Ahmedpur Police Station for the offences punishable under Section 188, 272, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and 3 911aba903.24 Standards Act, 2006 he shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs. 15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount on following conditions :
(a) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when required.
(b) The applicant shall not try to influence the investigation and co-operate with the investigating officer.
(c) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not try to pressurize the witnesses.

( KISHORE C. SANT ) JUDGE mahajansb/
